rationale: Bolaji and Kaushik both work in ML-adjacent domains with strong Python foundations, but bring complementary expertise: Bolaji focuses on AI tooling and infrastructure at Cohere, while Kaushik brings hands-on robotics and embedded systems experience from Mytra. They could explore how ML infrastructure patterns apply to robotics systems, or discuss how to bridge cloud tooling with real-world autonomous systems.
intro_message: Bolaji, meet Kaushik Prakash — he's a Senior ML Engineer at Mytra working on robotics and autonomous systems; given your infrastructure background at Cohere, you two might have interesting ideas on connecting ML tooling with embedded systems.
